head: working-tree
subject: gRPC xDS trusted_xds_server
change: runtime.Options.trusted_xds_server implements the gRPC xDS server feature of the same name. RDS automatic host rewriting is honored only when the control plane is trusted; an untrusted server's auto_host_rewrite is ignored instead of replacing the request :authority, matching grpc-core. The bootstrap parser already exposed the flag per server; the runtime and LDS controller now forward it into route selection.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/rds/tests.zig checks that the same auto_host_rewrite resource is ignored for an untrusted snapshot and applied for a trusted one. src/grpc/xds/lds/controller_tests.zig drives inline RDS through the public LDS controller for both option values and inspects the resolved request options. src/grpc/xds/rds/transport_tests.zig keeps the wire-level auto rewrite case on a trusted server. src/grpc/xds/bootstrap_tests.zig covers the server_features flag.

focused_gate.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC RDS' -Dtest-filter='gRPC LDS' -Dtest-filter='xDS runtime' -Dtest-filter='bootstrap' --summary all

notes: The feature is opt-in, matching grpc-core: a control plane must be declared trusted before RDS auto_host_rewrite may change :authority. grpc-core also uses the flag to accept google_grpc service credentials; netz does not implement google_grpc services, so that arm has no local counterpart.
